top_comments.text: Alternative title: How to burn your Claude subscribtion within one session

Seven advisors on one model are seven echoes of the same training. A board gets useful when the seats are different providers: we run Claude, Codex, Gemini and Grok on one desk, and route each call by task so only the hard ones hit the expensive model. That routing alone cut our API spend by ~80%.

I assess people's AI skills for a living, and the thing I'd stress-test here is whether the advisors actually disagree. If they all lean the same way, you have one model's opinion in five costumes. Try asking each one to name the single assumption most likely to be wrong in your plan, and the council becomes a check rather than a mood boost.
